brand.notes: Daikin AC for PK market (Daikin Industries Japan — MIA distributed, CKD since 2026; split inverter K-Series, Sensira FTXC-C R32, Sky Air). Primary sources: official global SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis PDF (high, 41) + K-Series service manual SiBE041213E (high, 28) + FTXC-C operation manual + ARC remote (high, 14). Letter+digit scheme (A1/P1/U4/E5/H6/C4/F3/J1/L5/A7 etc.) — model-scoped series files never merged where source families diverge. No PK-specific official table (daikin.com/pk 404, daikin.com.pk 406) — global chart applies to PK-sold families. No per-count LED blink map found (all blinkPattern null). Quarantines: VRV module codes out of PK residential scope, other-region/non-AC, other-brand tables.
